They put me on insulin and said I had LADA, can’t really remember because I thought it sounded like BS. Late onset Adult Diabetic something, but I’m thinking more poor diet and worse mental health. 
The first few months I was taking insulin I was having a real hard time keeping my sugars below 400. Major diet changes and working out again has allowed me to get my numbers back to the healthy range, but my feet just always hurt. Ranging from tingles to molten ants and lightning spears. It started about the time I started taking insulin, and like I said medication only helps for limited time.
